clue.text: Drive through American street

parts.note: thru is the American spelling of through

explanation.surface: A motorist drives through an American street.
explanation.definitionFit: A thrust is a forceful push or the driving force behind something, a synonym of drive.

clue.text: Warns numbers after earthquake

indicators.note: after means the numbers come behind the shaken earth

parts.note: the word earth, quaked or shaken, has its letters jumbled
tens are numbers

explanation.surface: Authorities issue warnings about the casualty figures after a quake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'earthquake' splits as EARTH plus 'quake', the shaking that rearranges it to THREA.
explanation.definitionFit: To warn of danger is to threaten that something bad is coming.

clue.text: Decorate the home anew, up and down

indicators.note: up and down says the letters read the same in both directions of this down entry

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Redecorating the house, working up and down the walls.
explanation.definitionFit: To hang fresh wallpaper is to decorate rooms over again.

clue.text: Seen across opening of cave — at least it might be

definitions.text: Seen across opening of cave — at least it might be

indicators.note: might be suggests the letters could form something else when rearranged
the opening of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A cave formation hangs across the mouth of the cave, or so it seems.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might be' rearranges C, AT LEAST and IT. A cave formation hangs from the roof across the cave opening.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the icicle-like mineral deposit hanging from a cave roof.

clue.text: Suggest imprisoning extreme lawbreaker

indicators.note: imprisoning means the first piece locks the second up inside it

parts.note: to suggest is to offer an idea
the extreme of anything is its end

explanation.surface: Someone proposes locking up the worst kind of criminal.
explanation.definitionFit: An offender is someone who commits a crime, a synonym of lawbreaker.

clue.text: Confront ministers? It's necessary to come clean!

parts.note: to face someone is to confront them
the cloth stands for the clergy as a body

explanation.surface: Challenging the clergy means they will have to confess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The cloth' is a traditional name for the clergy, from their distinctive dress.
explanation.definitionFit: A small towel for washing the face is what you need to get yourself clean.

clue.text: Some fear nothing, so make money

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some people fearlessly take risks and so get rich.
explanation.definitionFit: To earn is to receive money for work done.

clue.text: Racket produced by dance over the road

indicators.note: over means, in this down clue, the dance sits above the road

parts.note: a disco is a dance party

explanation.surface: A row caused by a dance held across the street.
explanation.definitionFit: Racket and discord both mean harsh noise or strife.

clue.text: Fabric made from old yarn? Wrong!

indicators.note: wrong signals the letters are set out in an incorrect order

explanation.surface: Complaining that a cloth is woven from second-hand thread.
explanation.definitionFit: Rayon is a synthetic cloth made from cellulose.

clue.text: Helen's mother arranged deal

indicators.note: arranged means the letters of the word are set in a new order

explanation.surface: Helen of Troy's mother fixed a bargain.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Leda, seduced by Zeus as a swan, bore Helen of Troy.

clue.text: Substitute dealing with the situation

parts.note: re means about or concerning, as in a business letter
a situation is a place or position

explanation.surface: A stand-in is brought in to handle the circumstances.
explanation.definitionFit: To replace something is to put a substitute in its stead, the verb sense of substitute.

clue.text: Bob is terse, and rejected assent

parts.note: curt and terse both mean brusquely short

indicators.note: rejected here means the word for assent is thrown back, read in reverse

parts.note: yes is a word of assent

explanation.surface: Someone named Bob is brusque and refuses to agree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' turns YES into SEY. Bob looks like a name, but here it is the verb: to bob is to make a small curtsy.
explanation.definitionFit: To bob is to dip the knees briefly in respect, which is what a curtsey is.

clue.text: Impression made by an attendant

parts.note: one sense is the impression or look of something; the other is what someone who attends an event puts in by turning up

explanation.definitionFit: An outward look or impression is one sense; turning up at an event is to put in this, as an attendant does.

clue.text: A fool one has to endure

definitions.meaning: a stupid person, an oaf or idiot
to keep going or continue, written as two words

explanation.surface: A fool is something one simply has to put up with.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is the phrase GO ON, continue or keep enduring, as in 'one has to go on'.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for an idiot or a hired thug; as two words it means to keep going.

clue.text: Split about leaving and going back

indicators.note: about means the word for split goes around the other piece

parts.note: to rive is to split or tear apart
egress is a going out or leaving

explanation.surface: A rift over departure turns into a retreat.
explanation.definitionFit: Regressive means returning to an earlier or less developed state.

clue.text: Man going round desert, wandering off course

indicators.note: going round means the first piece encircles the second

parts.note: Eric is a man's name
to rat is to desert one's side

explanation.surface: A man walks around a desert, straying from his route.
explanation.walkthrough: 'desert' looks like sand dunes, but it is the verb: a rat deserts a sinking ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Erratic behaviour is irregular and unpredictable, straying from a steady course.

clue.text: Opposed to procedure used in meeting

parts.note: con means against, as in pros and cons
a course of action is a procedure

explanation.surface: Objecting to the methods adopted at a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A concourse is a gathering or coming together of people.

clue.text: Late deliveries expected

parts.note: in cricket an over is a set of six deliveries (balls) bowled
due means expected, as in a train due at noon

explanation.surface: Parcels that were awaited have not yet arrived.
explanation.walkthrough: An OVER in cricket, Britain's summer bat-and-ball game, is a set of six balls bowled in turn.
explanation.definitionFit: Something overdue has not arrived by the expected time, so it is late.

clue.text: Preparing a list seen as vital

indicators.note: preparing suggests the letters are being worked into shape, so rearranged

explanation.surface: Drawing up a list is considered indispensable.
explanation.definitionFit: Essential and vital both mean absolutely necessary.

clue.text: Tough guy strikes back with lash

indicators.note: back here means the word for strikes is read from end to start

parts.note: raps are sharp strikes or blows
to tan someone's hide is to beat or lash them

explanation.surface: A hard man hits back with a whip.
explanation.definitionFit: A Spartan, like the soldiers of ancient Sparta, is a hardy person who endures hardship without complaint.

clue.text: Article on game that's cut short

indicators.note: on means, in this down clue, the article sits on top of the game

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
bridge is a card game

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece about a card game that was truncated.
explanation.definitionFit: To abridge is to shorten a text by cutting parts of it.

clue.text: Simple catalogues

parts.note: a simple is an old word for a medicinal plant, so catalogues of simples are books describing such plants

explanation.definitionFit: These are old books listing and describing plants and their healing uses, the simples of folk medicine.

clue.text: Left at the river-side as a decoy

parts.note: the Ure is a river in Yorkshire, northern England

explanation.walkthrough: L sits at the side of the Ure, a Yorkshire river much used in crosswords.

clue.text: Girl embracing Tory leader does carry on!

indicators.note: embracing means the girl wraps her arms around the other piece

parts.note: a lass is a girl

indicators.note: a word's leader is its first letter

explanation.surface: A girl hugs the head of the Conservatives and won't stop.
explanation.definitionFit: To last is to continue or go on, so lasts means carries on.

clue.text: Authority for payment of an allowance?

definitions.meaning: a warrant or official power to act, as an officer's
a percentage fee paid to an agent for each sale made

explanation.surface: Who has the power to authorise paying out an allowance?
explanation.definitionFit: Both a warrant granting powers and an agent's percentage fee go by this name.

clue.text: Debunk what's artificial

explanation.surface: Expose what is fake.
explanation.definitionFit: Both deriding something and a sham or imitation share this word.

clue.text: A slight lack of clariry in speech

definitions.meaning: words run together indistinctly when spoken

explanation.surface: A small failure to speak distinctly.
explanation.definitionFit: An insult or slander, and also indistinct, run-together pronunciation, share this word.

clue.text: One who makes money by backing horses?

definitions.text: One who makes money by backing horses?

parts.words: One who makes money by backing horses?
parts.note: suggests a gambler betting on races, but means a craftsman earning a living from what goes on horses' backs

explanation.definitionFit: This craftsman makes and sells the seats strapped on a horse's back for riding.

clue.text: Note following feature about a red wine

indicators.note: following means the note comes after the rest
about means the facial feature goes round the little word a

parts.note: the chin is a facial feature
ti (or te) is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A remark about the distinctive character of a red wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Chianti is a red wine from Tuscany in Italy.

clue.text: Ferment near English MPs who pointedly attack the opposition?

indicators.note: to ferment is to stir up and agitate, so these letters are churned into a new order

explanation.surface: Unrest brews among English politicians who make barbed attacks on the opposition benches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ferment' rearranges NEAR, E and MPS. The definition describes soldiers armed with spears, who attack with points.
explanation.definitionFit: Soldiers armed with long pointed weapons attack the enemy, literally with points.

clue.text: The heart of a military man's sound

indicators.note: sound means the word for the officer is heard, not read

parts.note: a colonel is a senior army officer

explanation.surface: The core of a soldier's healthy constitution.
explanation.walkthrough: COLONEL is pronounced exactly like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The kernel of something is its central, essential part, its heart or core.
